 Monsoon surge to bring continuous heavy rain from Nov 9 
 By Nuratikah Athilya Hassan 
 November 6, 2026 @ 4:39pm 
 MetMalaysia says the weather system could affect the east coast of the peninsula and eastern Sabah, with rain warnings issued for several districts in Kelantan, Terengganu and Sabah. NSTP/FILE PIC
 KUALA LUMPUR: A monsoon surge is expected to enter the country's region between Nov 9 and 11, potentially bringing continuous heavy rain to the east coast of Peninsular Malaysia and eastern Sabah.
 Malaysian Meteorological Department (MetMalaysia) director-general Dr Mohd Hisham Mohd Anip said weather forecast model analysis indicated the possibility of prolonged rainfall in the affected areas during the period.
 He said a Continuous Rain Warning (Alert) had also been issued for several areas in Kelantan and Terengganu, effective from Nov 8 to 11.
 "In Kelantan, the areas identified are Tanah Merah, Pasir Mas, Tumpat, Kota Baru, Machang, Bachok and Pasir Puteh.
 "In Terengganu, the warning covers Besut, Setiu, Kuala Nerus, Kuala Terengganu, Marang and Hulu Terengganu," he said in a statement today.
 Meanwhile, he said the same warning would be in force from Nov 9 to 11 for several areas in Sandakan, Sabah, covering Paitan, Telupid, Labuk and Sugut, Sandakan and Kinabatangan.
 "The public can obtain the latest weather information through MetMalaysia's official website, the myCuaca mobile application and the department's official social media platforms.
 "Further enquiries can be directed to the MetMalaysia hotline at 1-300-22-1638," he said.
